get.description: Returns a cursor-paginated list of publicly visible events. Filters apply before ordering. Same-field values use OR; different fields use AND. Date boundaries are interpreted in Africa/Cairo (inclusive from, exclusive next-day to). No authentication is required.

parameters.description: Repeated for OR semantics. Allowed: published, on_sale, sold_out, sales_closed, live, completed, cancelled
parameters.name: state

parameters.description: Repeated for OR/overlap semantics. Max 20 unique values, 80 chars each.
parameters.name: tag

parameters.description: When true, filters to upcoming events (not started yet, expected to become live).
parameters.name: upcoming

parameters.description: When true, includes cancelled events in the result.
parameters.name: includeCancelled

parameters.description: Filter by earliest startsAt (Cairo date, inclusive).
parameters.name: startsFrom

parameters.description: Filter by latest startsAt (Cairo date, exclusive next day).
parameters.name: startsTo

parameters.description: Filter by earliest endsAt (Cairo date, inclusive).
parameters.name: endsFrom

parameters.description: Filter by latest endsAt (Cairo date, exclusive next day).
parameters.name: endsTo

parameters.description: Filter by earliest salesCloseAt (Cairo date, inclusive).
parameters.name: salesCloseFrom

parameters.description: Filter by latest salesCloseAt (Cairo date, exclusive next day).
parameters.name: salesCloseTo

parameters.description: Ignored. The API always returns English responses.
parameters.name: Accept-Language

400.description: Invalid event filters or cursor query.

parameters.description: Ignored. The API always returns English responses.
